purpose: Verify forward and backward traversal along the intent chain. AC-402-3 is pending: forward trace deliberately surfaces FBS via cross-link (D4), contradicting the AC's never-FBS clause (see test-suites/PENDING.md).
title: Trace forward and back

testCases.description: forward trace from a REQ returns the US, AC, TS and TC beneath it
testCases.testPointer: test/query/trace.test.js::forward from REQ returns US -> AC -> TS -> TC subtree

testCases.description: backward trace from an AC returns exactly US, REQ and PRD
testCases.testPointer: test/query/trace.test.js::back from AC walks AC -> US -> REQ -> PRD

testCases.description: forward trace surfaces the delivering FBS as a cross-link leaf and does not walk into its dependents
testCases.testPointer: test/query/trace.test.js::forward from AC includes FBS via fbsByAcId cross-link as a leaf, never traversed through (AC-402-3)

testCases.description: backward trace walks the intent chain only, with no FBS nodes
testCases.testPointer: test/query/trace.test.js::back from AC walks AC -> US -> REQ -> PRD
